contenido:
Hi everyone. Life doesn't always give us the time or opportunities we want, when we want them, or in the way we’d like.
 Over the last two months, dealing with various family and personal situations, I was forced to slow down and eventually take a break from my favorite hobby: bot-making.
This break gave me a chance to reflect; while no one ever truly stays the same, I think I’ve found a way to make my new life work alongside this hobby I love so much. So, instead of simply quitting, I’m choosing the path of the hermit. Time away from social media and janitor duties made me realize that I simply "can't keep up the pace" with everything. From now on, my approach will be to release bots "when they're ready" or "when I feel like it." Of course, this means far less interaction and self-promotion, but I’ve set before a nice goal i fulfilled somehow, the "2,000" mark to satisfy my own ego— so I can focus on creating purely for the fun of it. I won't be keeping track of events or trends anymore; I’ll be practically absent from the servers, chatting mainly in Madhouse and Botforge while stepping back from the others.
Of course, that doesn't mean you can DM me or message me on the servers. I love talking to you all, but I can no longer keep up with all the notifications. Please humor me with some chat about bots from time to time. 
I hope this puts your minds at ease—I haven't disappeared. I’m just changing my pace and, likely, my content. I also want to write stories about my characters and share chats and concepts—even if it’s just like a logbook. It makes me happy to expand on these little creations and characters we’ve enjoyed together.
I’ve also created a small website to explore my vision for the bots a bit more : https://vibe-gallery-xi.vercel.app/
The idea of this site is to highlight some bots or content I want to have more attention and maybe to play a little with my web skills.

As for the bots, I’ll continue posting various things on different sites. I’ll share more details later on.

Now talking about some classification I was making...

Channels: It’s a way to group bots... yeah, another crazy idea—who knows how long it’ll last, but humor me. I’ll organize the bots like TV or streaming channels, with each channel featuring its own specific content... "Madverse" will consist of darker, crazier bots; "Fluff and Stuff" is self-explanatory; and "Gameverse" will feature *Lost Sword* and *Persona*. Major sagas—like *Seiyo Academy*, which has a huge number of bots—will naturally have their own dedicated channel...

Sagas/Worlds: Groupings based on tags that already link related bots sharing the same story or interconnected storylines:
Luke Terrible Dates, Stalked by Kara, Hypnosis App, Selene Wife
